title.narrative: Operating the Prosthetics and Rehabilitation Center in Aden Governorate

description.narrative: Provides the needs for the manufacture and installation of (500) new limbs and rehabilitation, follow-up and repair supplies for (2200) injured and sick, providing the center’s services to (2700) beneficiaries

Providing physical rehabilitation services for people with special needs, following them up and benefiting from them in community service, diagnosis, determining the treatment plan for each patient individually, installing all kinds of prosthetic limbs, providing functional rehabilitation service for prosthetic limbs, following up on them, raising the capabilities of the medical and technical staff professionally and scientifically, and preparing them to deal with specific cases. Reducing the migration of medical and technical cadres specialized in the localization and improvement of prosthetic and rehabilitation services, assisting people with special needs by engaging them in social life, maintaining their continuity of performance within the elements of civil society, and raising the capabilities of workers in the prosthetics center with the latest medical sciences
